description: Commission of Elections - Declare that Shabitha  Umma as a Member of the Eravur Urban Council
reasoning: This gazette concerns filling a vacancy in a local government council (Eravur Urban Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically addresses the electoral process for a local authority position, including the nomination and declaration of a new council member to fill a vacancy caused by death. This falls squarely under election-related matters as defined in Type 7 (Elections Gazettes), which includes candidate nominations, registrations, and declarations related to electoral processes.
